budget_rationale: Both providers cap combined reasoning plus final output at 65536 tokens. Qwen also caps thinking at 16384; DeepSeek high remains a different provider-defined effort. Do not claim equivalent compute.
execution: At most 2 concurrent fresh sessions per provider; fixed shuffled submission order; no automatic retry.

interval_scope: Descriptive 95% intervals conditional on the fixed selected devices/runs and observed grouped-session predictions. Resampling devices/runs does not rerun the model or capture dependence induced by a shared batch, model/session variability, selection bias, or benchmark contamination. They are not full independent-experiment intervals.
limitations: Exploratory addition after original results; API and inference settings differ across providers.
